clue.text: In Kerala one may hear this rising just the same

clue.text: Lie about endless money

clue.text: Brief encounter leads to meeting in station — heartbreak after terrible risk

explanation.definitionFit: A skirmish is a short, minor fight between small forces, an encounter that is quickly over.

clue.text: Viceroy under King Edward in queen's domain

explanation.definitionFit: The khedive was the title of the Ottoman viceroy who governed Egypt in the nineteenth century.

clue.text: Pretty boys learn a dance

clue.text: Girl brought up in Tenerife

clue.text: Proverbial loser recollecting where it's at after scratching head

explanation.definitionFit: According to the proverb, the person who hesitates is lost, so one who dithers is the loser.
